En el recall, sus pasajes quedan por deb: In recall, its passages rank below documents of equal relevance, and they reach the agent marked as a chat conversation.
Si quieres que el agente lo encuentre, i: If you want the agent to find it, index it as a conversation: its passages will rank below documents of equal relevance. If it isn't a conversation, index it as an ordinary document.
Su texto son sobre todo turnos de un cha: Its text is mostly the turns of a chat or a meeting, so it is not chunked and does not reach recall: what was said in a conversation is not worth the same as documentation. You can read and download it.
Un administrador del brain puede indexar: A brain administrator can index it as a conversation or as a document.
